The *Upālittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 8) is a canonical verse text belonging to the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. As part of the biographical poetry collection honoring prominent elder disciples (*thera*), the poem recounts the deeds and karmic background of the elder Upāli. SuttaCentral records five modern translations across five languages, and notes connections or citations of the text in conjunction with the *Āḷavaka Sutta* (SN 10.12 / Snp 1.10), the *Yāgudāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 420), and the *Āsaṅkajātaka* (Ja 380) [SuttaCentral].

Regarding parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral lists curated passage-level parallels within the Therāpadāna to the *Sāriputtattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 3) and two accounts of Upavāna (*Upavānattheraapadāna*, Tha-Ap 24 and Tha-Ap 562), along with resembling parallels in the *Maṇipūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 474) and the *Mahāvāṇijajātaka* (Ja 493) [SuttaCentral].
